_description: CVE vulnerability-ranking experiment matrix (feature: cve-vulnerability-ranking). Each experiment resolves as base config + overrides; the runner (run_experiments.py) executes convert -> split -> Stage 1 -> Stage 2 -> predict -> evaluate and aggregates a cross-experiment summary. All experiments share split_seed for comparability; experiments with the same 'split' reuse one materialized split. NOTE: the base config (stage1_contrastive.json) is ORDINAL and already sets cve_positive_signal=priority_band + cve_negative_cross_band=true, so the former E6/E8 (which merely re-asserted those) resolved identically to E1, and E9 resolved identically to E7. Those three exact duplicates were pruned; the 7 experiments below are the distinct Stage-1 configs. IDs are preserved (E0-E5, E7) so they map to previously-run results.

experiments.name: no-stage1 baseline
experiments.description: Honest reference: Stage 2 supervised heads over the FROZEN base sentence-transformer embeddings, with NO contrastive pretraining (no Stage 1). Any gain of the ordinal Stage 1 experiments over E0 is the value of the ordinal contrastive pretraining.

experiments.name: base ordinal contrastive
experiments.description: The default ordinal Stage 1: same-band positives + cross-band ontology-tiered negatives (inherited from the base config) with NO sample weighting (ontology_weight=0). The reference ordinal configuration.

experiments.name: label-completeness weighting
experiments.description: E1 + principled, ontology-INDEPENDENT sample weighting by label-completeness quality tier (ontology_weight=0.3, overlap off).

experiments.name: ontology-overlap weighting (ablation)
experiments.description: E2 + the self-referential ontology-overlap sample weight (ontology_weight=0.3, overlap on). Tests whether re-using the pairing signal as a weight helps or hurts vs E2.

experiments.name: hard-negative emphasis
experiments.description: E1 with a harder negative mix (tiers 0.7/0.2/0.1) to test whether emphasizing ontology-hard negatives sharpens the embedding.

experiments.name: temporal split
experiments.description: E1 configuration but a TEMPORAL split (train on older CVEs, test on newer) to measure generalization to future vulnerabilities rather than a random/stratified holdout.

experiments.name: ontology-refined positives
experiments.description: E1 but positives must share the anchor's priority_band AND (preferably) an ontology token, falling back to same-band-only. Tests whether adding topical relatedness on top of the band alignment helps or hurts vs the pure same-band positives in E1. (Former E9 == this config and was pruned.)
